title: Haldi as celestial intelligence rather than ancient aliens

tellings.quote: has been a bit skewed from what I look at with these Gods like haldi it seems more like some kind of celestial intelligence

plain: A researcher named Matt, talking in 2024 with podcast host Jesse Michels, discusses Haldi, a god worshipped in ancient times around Lake Van in eastern Turkey. He says the usual reading of gods like Haldi has been skewed, and that to him Haldi seems more like some kind of celestial intelligence than an ancient alien visitor. If true, it would mean the old gods were memories of a contact with something in the heavens.
